integrity.scientific_basis: Exact exhaustive integer enumeration, switching reduction, trace/determinant verification, analytic operator norm comparison

scientific_limitations: Explicit Paley skew-conference matrix of order twenty only; six possible Seidel polynomials already known in the 2024 literature; no arbitrary-order multiplicity or global optimal frame comparison.
title: Six-erasure spectral multiplicities of the twenty-vector Paley conference frame
